title: Typical teenage husky talk back 😂🤭
description:
Just another day with a teenager talking back to his father! 😂

Marble was peeved that Dad encroached on his giving of puppy dog eyes to Mama for some table scraps and decided to tell him to back off, which of course Dad was not having.
